CREATE PROC [BNKM].[SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYMENTCARD_CCD] AS
BEGIN
--GET DELTA FROM BUSC

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard
AS(
    SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId, PaymentCardId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimestamp DESC, Monthly_Daily ) RN, * FROM (
    SELECT
    BCC.CARD_ACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CARD_NBR AS PaymentCardId
    ,CONVERT(datetime2,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN )) as PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,CASE
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(datetime2,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE)) 
    END AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN )) as PaymentCardIssuedDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE))
    END AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
    ,BCC.CARD_CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ORG_NBR_EFFDTE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_ORG_NBR_EFFDTE))
    END AS OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_BPS = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_BPS))
    END AS BPSJoinDate
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
    ,BCC. CARD_FORMAT_ID AS PaymentCardFormatId
    ,getdate() AS InsertDttm
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,1 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARFP BCC
    WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'

UNION


SELECT
    BCC.CARD_ACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
    ,BCC.CARD_NBR AS PaymentCardId
    ,CONVERT(datetime2,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN )) as PeriodStartTimestamp
    ,CASE
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(datetime2,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_CLOSE)) 
    END AS PeriodEndTimestamp
    ,CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_OPEN )) as PaymentCardIssuedDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_ACTIVATION_DATE))
    END AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
    ,BCC.CARD_CUST_NBR AS CustomerId
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_ORG_NBR_EFFDTE = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_ORG_NBR_EFFDTE))
    END AS OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate
    ,CASE 
        WHEN BCC.CARD_DTE_BPS = 0 THEN '1900-01-01'
        ELSE CONVERT(date,CONVERT(varchar, BCC.CARD_DTE_BPS))
    END AS BPSJoinDate
    ,BCC.CARD_SUP_REL AS PaymentCardHolderTypeId
    ,BCC. CARD_FORMAT_ID AS PaymentCardFormatId
    ,getdate() AS InsertDttm
    ,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,2 AS Monthly_Daily
    FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCARDP BCC
    WHERE BCC.ISLATEST = '1'
)A
)




SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard WHERE RN = 1;


--CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_SRC
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
    CONVERT(datetime2, PeriodEndTimestamp)
    ,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardIssuedDate)
    ,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardActivationTimestamp)
    ,CONVERT(varchar, CustomerId)
    ,CONVERT(date, OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate)
    ,CONVERT(date, BPSJoinDate)
    ,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardHolderTypeId)
    ,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardFormatId)
    )) HASHROW,
    CustomerAccountId, PaymentCardId, PeriodStartTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard
)

,

TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_TGT
AS(
    SELECT
    HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
    CONVERT(datetime2, PeriodEndTimestamp)
    ,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardIssuedDate)
    ,CONVERT(date, PaymentCardActivationTimestamp)
    ,CONVERT(varchar, CustomerId)
    ,CONVERT(date, OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate)
    ,CONVERT(date, BPSJoinDate)
    ,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardHolderTypeId)
    ,CONVERT(nvarchar, PaymentCardFormatId)
    )) HASHROW,
    CustomerAccountId, PaymentCardId, PeriodStartTimestamp, FinancialInstitutionId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard
    WHERE PeriodStartTimestamp IS NULL OR PeriodEndtimestamp = '1900-01-01'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA
AS(
    SELECT
    SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
    ,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId, TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,ISNULL(SRC.PaymentCardId, TGT.PaymentCardId) AS PaymentCardId
	,ISNULL(SRC.FinancialInstitutionId, TGT.FinancialInstitutionId) AS FinancialInstitutionId
    ,CASE
		WHEN TGT.HASHROW IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
    FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_SRC SRC
    LEFT JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_TGT TGT
    ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
	AND SRC.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
	AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
   WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW
OR TGT.HASHROW IS NULL
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA

--UPDATE RECORDS TO BNKM

UPDATE TGT
SET
PeriodEndTimestamp = SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA DELTA
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND DELTA.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard SRC
ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
AND SRC.PaymentCardId = TGT.PaymentCardId
AND SRC.FinancialInstitutionId = TGT.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL;


--INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountPaymentCard(
CustomerAccountId
,PaymentCardId
,PeriodStartTimestamp
,PeriodEndTimestamp
,PaymentCardIssuedToPartyId
,PaymentCardIssuedDate
,PaymentCardExpirationDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,CustomerCode
,BankIdentificationNumber
,PinRequiredIndicator
,PinNumber
,CustomerAccountPaymentCardNote
,CustomerId
,MembershipFeeDueDate
,OriginalPaymentCardId
,OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate
,BPSJoinDate
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardFormatId
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkflowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT DISTINCT
SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,SRC.PaymentCardId AS PaymentCardId
,SRC.PeriodStartTimestamp AS PeriodStartTimestamp
,SRC.PeriodEndTimestamp AS PeriodEndTimestamp
,NULL AS PaymentCardIssuedToPartyId
,PaymentCardIssuedDate AS PaymentCardIssuedDate
,NULL AS PaymentCardExpirationDate
,PaymentCardActivationTimestamp AS PaymentCardActivationTimestamp
,NULL AS CustomerCode
,NULL AS BankIdentificationNumber
,NULL AS PinRequiredIndicator
,NULL AS PinNumber
,NULL AS CustomerAccountPaymentCardNote
,CustomerId AS CustomerId
,NULL AS MembershipFeeDueDate
,NULL AS OriginalPaymentCardId
,OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate AS OriginalPaymentCardEffectiveDate
,BPSJoinDate AS BPSJoinDate
,PaymentCardHolderTypeId
,PaymentCardFormatId
,'CCD' SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkflowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA DELTA 
ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId
     AND DELTA.PaymentCardId = SRC.PaymentCardId
     AND DELTA.FinancialInstitutionId = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('INSERT')


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountPaymentCard_DELTA;


END
GO
